thread:
morgan: Quick q — noticed that when a fncall gets rejected by schema validation and we fall back to the text route, our KV cache metrics in the console show up as 0 or disappear. Is that expected or a telemetry gap?

lina: Yep seen this. KV cache instrumented only on success path right now. Fallbacks skip the cache emit.

samir: That was intentional originally to avoid double-counting tokens for billing, but we probably need separate telemetry.

olivia: Can we tag emits with fallback_reason instead of skipping? e.g. fallback=\"schema_reject\" so we still see cache hits but don't bill them?

morgan: Exactly — we want visibility for rollouts/UX without changing billing signals. Ideally console can show those as a separate series.

samir: Implementation idea: instead of conditional emit, always emit kvcache.* metrics but set metric.label.fallback=true + fallback.reason. Billing pipeline ignores that label.

lina: That works if console and dashboards can filter on the label. Current dashboard only has route and model tags.

console-bot: Heads-up: dashboard \"fncall kvcache by route\" uses route, env, model. No fallback dimension yet.

olivia: Example metric lines we could start emitting (sampling?):
```
fncall.kvcache.hit_count{route=\"web-ui\",fallback=\"schema_reject\"} 42
fncall.kvcache.miss_count{route=\"web-ui\",fallback=\"schema_reject\"} 8
fncall.attempted_tokens{route=\"web-ui\",fallback=\"schema_reject\"} 1234
```

morgan: Nice. Two practical Qs: 1) do we want to emit at full traffic or sample? 2) who wires up console filters and the rollout UX?

samir: I'd prefer sampled emits (1%) to start for high-traffic routes. We can tag with sample=true so we understand representativeness.

lina: I'll sketch a console mock to add a fallback filter and a toggle to \"include fallbacks\" in the UI. UX should be per-route.

olivia: On the runtime side I'll add the label and a feature flag to switch sampling rate. Also will ensure billing extractor filters by fallback!=true.

infra-bot: deploy queued: kvcache-metrics-add-labels -> infra/prod (owner: olivia)

morgan: Great. Can we also add an event log whenever fallback_rate > 5% for a route so product/SEs can get a ping?

samir: Yep we can create an alert based on the new metric series. I suggest a 5% threshold with 5m eval window.

lina: I'll update the dashboard notes and add a canned saved filter \"show fallbacks\".

olivia: Action items: (1) runtime label + sampling flag (olivia) (2) billing extractor update to ignore fallback labels (samir) (3) console filter + saved view + alert (lina) (4) small experiment to run at 1% then scale (morgan)

morgan: Thanks all. Let's aim to ship sampling and console filter this week and revisit after 48h of data. :thumbsup:

console-bot: Note: I've filed a dashboard ticket CH-4217 and added to eng-platform board.

infra-bot: deploy started: kvcache-metrics-add-labels -> infra/prod

olivia: I'll post a follow-up with the flag name and example metrics once live.

morgan: Perfect — ping here when the dashboard shows anything.
